pixel_observations.description: Grayscale B-mode ultrasound clip on a black background with a dark blue banner across the top that carries no legible text. Printed device text at the upper left reads AP 96.6% MI 1.4 TIS 1.1 with a red heart symbol, and at the upper right the logo Mindray, M9T and a settings list (B, F PH3.4, D 15.0, G 67, FR 29, DR 115, iClear 4, Echo Boost). A green line with a pink tick runs along the bottom. At 0 s four dark chambers are separated by brighter walls; at 1 s and 2 s the dark cavity is elongated with bright elongated structures moving in the lower part; at 3 s a bright oval structure sits inside the dark cavity. No colour Doppler, arrow, patient name, clock or date is visible.
